name: Suzuoka Ren
source:
Favorite Color: Any Refined Color Combination
Special Skills: Traditional Japanese Dance
Hobby: Teasing the Protagonist
Feelings Toward the Protagonist: And Important Friend/I won't forgive anyone that would make her cry

2nd year university student.
The protagonist's childhood friend. She really treasures her and often gives her advice.
A beautiful cross-dresser and top Takarazuka star.
